motto.text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.

items.title: Twelve coastal states agree to keep one shared ledger for fishing quotas
items.summary: Negotiators settled on a single public record of catches after three years of talks, replacing a patchwork of national logbooks that rarely agreed. The ledger opens to inspectors in the spring and to the public a year later.

items.title: First night train runs through the new mountain rail tunnel after fourteen years of digging
items.summary: The 57-kilometre bore cuts the overnight journey between the two capitals by almost three hours. Freight operators begin booking slots in January.

items.title: Rains end early across the southern plateau, easing flood fears downstream
items.summary: Forecasters said river levels should fall through the weekend, letting relief crews reopen two closed highways.

items.title: Port Calder handles its busiest month in five years as holiday orders land
items.summary: Container moves rose 14 percent from a year earlier, and the port authority says a second night shift will stay on through January. Trucking firms report waits of up to four hours at the north gate.

items.title: Regional credit unions cut fees on small-business accounts
items.summary: Four lenders in the valley dropped monthly charges on accounts under $50,000, a move analysts tie to competition from online banks.

items.title: How to read your utility bill before winter rates arrive
items.summary: A line-by-line guide to delivery charges, supply rates and the budget-billing option most households never switch on.
items.why: Riverside Power's winter rates take effect on December 1.

items.title: Hilltop observatory tracks a comet brightening faster than forecast
items.summary: Astronomers say the comet could be visible with binoculars before dawn next week if it holds together. The observatory will open its dome to visitors on Saturday night.

items.title: Cover crops held twice as much winter moisture, a ten-year soil study finds
items.summary: Fields planted with rye and clover between harvests kept more water in the top metre of soil, with the largest gains in dry years.
items.why: You follow the farm co-op's switch to cover crops.

items.title: Volunteer bird count logs a record flock of waxwings along the river
items.summary: Counters tallied more than 900 birds feeding on winter berries near the old mill race.

items.title: Northgate Bridge reopens to walkers and cyclists three weeks ahead of schedule
items.summary: The 1912 stone bridge reopened at dawn with a new deck, restored lamps and a widened path on the upstream side. Cars return in the spring once the approach roads are rebuilt, and the city will decide by then whether to keep one lane for bicycles.
items.why: You asked to follow the Northgate Bridge repairs.

items.title: Library board approves Sunday hours at the Eastbank branch
items.summary: The branch will open from noon to five starting in January, paid for by moving two weekday evening hours.

items.title: Saturday market moves indoors to the old tram depot for the winter
items.summary: Thirty-two stalls make the move this weekend, with hot cider, a bread swap and the first winter squash.

items.title: Leaf collection reaches the north side next week
items.summary: Rake leaves to the curb, not into the street, by 7 a.m. on your usual trash day.

items.title: Keep the Northgate Bridge for people on foot
items.summary: The reopened span has shown what the river crossing can be without traffic. The council should make the trial permanent.
items.stance: The bridge should stay closed to cars.

items.title: Downtown needs benches, not more wayfinding signs
items.summary: Places to sit are what bring people back to a main street, and they cost less than the sign program the city is weighing.
items.stance: Small comforts do more for downtown than signs.

items.title: Teach budgeting in middle school, before the first overdraft
items.summary: A semester of household money basics would save more families than any fee cap.
items.stance: Money basics belong in the middle-school timetable.
